checks.note: getOrCreateStripeCustomer saves paymentMethodId to stripe_customers before paymentGateway.chargeAndCapture, which has no failure handling in purchasePack; the gateway cannot restore the old card since previousCard is a local never passed to it and the row already holds the new card. On a successful retry with the same card, previousCard equals paymentMethodId, so scheduleSubscriptionCardSync's Objects.equals guard returns early and savePaymentMethodAndScheduleSync is skipped, leaving subscriptions on the old card.

In purchasePack, the tier.isActive() check and BookingService.requireBookableCoachStatus run before chargeAndCapture, and the replay lookup findByStripePaymentIntentId only occurs after the charge — so a same-attemptKey retry after createTier deactivated the tier throws payment.packTierInactive without ever reaching the replayedPurchase path, despite the pack already being charged and recorded.
